title: Six genuine stacks from the final policy
note: Last checkpoint of the two-finger carry-shaped run, recorded at the stiff OSC gains it trained under. 51 episodes, 11 successes, 6 of them lasting past the 10-step boundary below which a success is only a reset that spawned solved — 21, 22, 32, 35 and 42 steps, final errors 2.6-4.9 mm against a 5 mm tolerance. Every one ends with the cube at rest (0.0-2 mm/s) and the hand withdrawn 149-176 mm: the success predicate requires neither, so release is measured rather than assumed.
